CC-11.target: spec v1.2 sec.2.8 K-19 (and the table in sec.3.4')
CC-11.old: 'B x dir2 -> a = -e0 (36/36 cells with exactly 1 hit)'
CC-11.new: The count 36/36 is correct. The sign statement is NOT: B x dir2 gives a = -e0 only on the 18 cells with chi = +1 (layers m = 0, 9). On the 18 cells with chi = -1 (layers m = 8, 17) dir2 gives a = +e0, the SAME as dir1.
CC-11.proof: for chi = -1 the label map rho_lab : j -> -j - e0 is an INVOLUTION, so rho = rho^-1 and the dir1 and dir2 right-hand sides rho^-1 Ybar rho and rho Ybar rho^-1 are literally the same permutation. At chi = -1 DIR is vacuous not merely as a pin but as a DISTINCTION.
CC-11.machine: connect_ben1_arch_out.txt, block 'monomial layers: value of a'
CC-11.already_visible_in: the second prescout's own output fal_c2_bits_out.txt B1 says 'mixed/none' for B x dir2, and fal_c2_bits2_out.txt B6 prints the m=8 / m=17 rows as +e0. The v1.2 PROSE over-summarised machine output that was already finer.
CC-11.impact_on_conclusions: NONE. The measurement primes 19/37/73 sit in layer m = 9 (chi = +1) where dir1 and dir2 genuinely differ (+e0 vs -e0), so the DIR bit is live exactly where it matters, and DC-21 kills dir2 in the chi != +-1 layers.
CC-11.sharpened_statement: the three regimes are disjoint: chi = +1 -> DIR distinction LIVE, DIR pin VACUOUS (this is the measurement layer); chi = -1 -> distinction DEAD and pin VACUOUS; chi != +-1 -> distinction LIVE and pin NON-VACUOUS (this is DC-21). This is a sharper reason why DC-21 is indispensable.
